SECTION 22 DECISION (PARTIALLY MIGRATE). The plan's Project 01 structure has no Application/ layer; Services/ is the application/use-case layer. This class is use-case orchestration, so it belongs in Services/. The plan provides no Services/Asset/ capability, and its own contract states it serves Discovery, Campaign Planner and Price Estimator, so Services/Campaign/ is its correct capability owner. Created in Phase 0.18, so this is a correction of that phase's assumption rather than a legacy migration.
